text:
[IRET.11.3.2] A fired match stays refracted until its activation is
re-created: its token re-asserted under a new wrapper, retracted, released
by a negated condition of its rule, or ended by a time-dependent test that
went false and made again when the test goes true ([LTIM.2.5.1]). Nothing
else releases it — not an unrelated assert or retract, not a pump boundary,
and not a clock tick under which its match persists ([LDET.5.8]). A match
blocked and released within one pump is re-created and may fire again.

The flag carries this, not the table. A generation's turnover — every
working-memory assert and retract, and each pump — leaves every table entry
stale, but releases no match: an activation the change did not reach keeps
its flag and is not selected again, and one it did reach is re-created. The
table's entries matter only within one generation; a clock-driven match
formed again on every tick is held by the edge-once set ([IRET.11.3.5]).

idris.name: ldet_5_8__tick_keeps_activation_clocked
idris.note: A tick clears no refraction: the fired activation whose match persists keeps its flag through the re-time.

idris.name: iret_11_3_2__insert_g
idris.note: A fact asserted begins a new cycle: the set is cleared.

idris.name: iret_11_3_2__insert_sound
idris.note: A FACT ASSERTED keeps the ghost sound: the view is kept, and the cleared set refuses nothing.

idris.name: iret_11_3_2__retract_g
idris.note: A fact retracted begins a new cycle: the set is cleared.

idris.name: iret_11_3_2__retract_sound
idris.note: A FACT RETRACTED keeps the ghost sound.

idris.name: iret_11_3__refraction_after_history
idris.note: The clause's clearing is what makes the set unobservable: between two clearings the terminals change only by marking, so the set never holds an identity whose activation is unfired. The clearing is a safe over-approximation of [LDET.5.3]'s 'until its LHS changes'.

idris.name: iret_19_1__assert_r
idris.note: What assert does to the set: cleared on every path that changes working memory, kept on a suppressed reassertion, which asserts no new fact.

idris.name: lscp_2_1_1__withdraw_r
idris.note: What withdraw does to the set: cleared when a live fact leaves, kept when there was nothing to withdraw.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__tick_keeps_activation
idris.note: A TICK IS NOT A CHANGE TO THE LHS: an activation whose match the new test still admits is the same record after the tick, its `fired` flag included. A fired match stays refracted across every tick that leaves it matching -- Rete/NetworkRefraction.idr's theorem, restated under ticks.

tla.name: iret_11_3_2__chgC
tla.note: An unrelated working-memory change. The clause says it clears no identity, and under the flag reading (column `own`) it clears nothing. The model also runs the refused reading `anywm`, which clears every identity on any assert or retract; this event is what separates the two (stream `tick_reeval`).
